verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a read-only Stats API whose /api/v2/query endpoint takes simple and complex queries and returns JSON metrics, covering historical and real-time stats with team-scoped API keys. An agent could therefore query live analytics data through the API. However, there is no evidence of an MCP server, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so agent-ready integration is unproven. missing for 10: official MCP server, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, agent/LLM-oriented docs (llms.txt), hands-on evidence of an agent answering growth questions via the API.
